errorDocument.description: A relative path of the S3 file in the bucket. This file serves for 4xx errors, or null if no error document has been specified.

indexDocument.description: The name of the S3 file at the root level of the bucket. This file serves as the home page of the hosting website.

title: Represents a AWS S3 bucket's configuration as a static website.
name: AwsS3BucketWebsiteConfig
